args.text: vp_sln_s7_06 dealership, final e80a6f8bed28be7bd5d665dd84f342c07d3f74ee1bded1699c13de3c38e9eb85 GLB: Both fresh rear-quarter and rotated side/front views show the main body, doors, mirrors, wheels, rear lights and wing seated together.
